PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Barnstead Smart2Pure UV/UF 12 L/hr. Water Purification System
PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Barnstead Smart2Pure UV/UF 12 L/hr. Water Purification System
DESCRIPTION:
Convert tap water to both ASTM Type 1 and Type 2 water with the compact, all-in-one Thermo Scientific™ Barnstead™ Smart2Pure™ Water Purification System. This complete system produces 3 or 6 liters of ultra-pure water per hour. The Smart2Pure 3 and 6 feature a built-in 6L reservoir to store the Type 2 water, while the Smart2Pure 12 offers the choice of a 30 or 60L reservoir for customizable storage capacity. Dispensing is easy and features variable speed to control flow, and the display can be tilted for optimal reading. Position this system on the bench or mount on the wall. Based on your requirements, choose from capacities of 3, 6 or 12 L/hr. All systems include an RO/pretreatment cartridge, ultrapure polisher cartridge, sterile 0.2 m filter, pressure regulator, UV lamp and/or UF filter where applicable. The 3 and 6 lph models also include an internal 6L tank with vent filter.

• Water purification progresses through independent cartridges with Aquastop quick connects for fast replacement
• Module 1 - Combination of pretreatment and the reverse osmosis membrane
• Module 2 - Polishing cartridge contains high-quality ultrapure resin for consistent purity and long cartridge life
• Dispensing is easy and features variable speed to control flow
• The display can be tilted for optimal reading
• All units require a pretreatment filter to prolong cartridge life (Cat. No. 889-76312)
• Optional UV bulb and UF ultrafilter to customize ultrapure waters
• Gain increased flexibility by adding an optional hand dispenser with 3m cord (Cat. No. 889-79857)
• Warranty: 1 year, parts and labor

Smart integrated 6L reservoir for the Smart2Pure 3 and 6:
• Constructed with pigment-free materials
• Conical bottom outlet allows for complete draining and efficient cleaning and disinfection

Smart2Pure 12 offers reservoir options, either 30 or 60 L:
• Large opening for easy and effective cleaning by hand
• Sterile venting filter/reservoir overflow protects against contamination by microorganisms
• Optional CO2 absorber (Cat. No. 889-76296) prevents TOC value increases from drawn-in CO2
• Polyethylene reservoir (SOLD SEPARATELY) is opaque to light
• Recirculation pump protects the high purity water from bacterial growth during standstills and maintains the low conductivity value
• Conical bottom outlet allows for complete draining and efficient cleaning and disinfection

Specifications:
• Flow rate: up to 1 L/min.
• Operating pressure min./max.: 29 to 87 psi (2 to 6 bar)
• Electrical requirements: 90-240V, 50/60 Hz
• Power consumption: 0.06 kW
• Feed water connector: 3/4 in. NPT
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 12 x 15.7 x 21.5 in.
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Spectrum Sterile MCE Syringe Filters, Porosity 0.45 um, Diameter 25 mm
PRODUCT_NAME: Spectrum Sterile MCE Syringe Filters, Porosity 0.45 um, Diameter 25 mm
DESCRIPTION:
Mixed Cellulose Esters (MCE) syringe filters are hydrophilic and are recommended for all filtrations in aqueous or polar media and bacteria filtration. They are ideal when maximum protein recovery in filtrate is crucial. These filters are also used for filtration and inspection of gas, oil and alcohol particulate and bacteria. Combined with a glass microfiber prefilter, they become ideal for tissue culture media and sensitive biological samples. Sample filtration prefilter increases yield.

Spectrum MCE Syringe Filters are:
• Disposable
• Luer-Lok and pressure fitting
• Ultrasonically bonded for reliability
• Clearly inscribed with the filter media type on barrel
• Excellent unit-to-unit and lot-to-lot reproducibility and consistency
• Made of high purity virgin polypropylene housing, no dyes or pigments added
• Individually blistered packed for Sterile filters or polybagged for non-sterile filters
• Unique with a concentric funnel shaped barrel to increase volume and decrease back pressure
